s1.syndrome_frame: lesion on the eyelid with conjunctival and eyelid abnormalities
salient_findings: pearly lesion on the left lower eyelid
contraction of the conjunctival mucosal tissue
increased scleral show of the ocular prosthesis
key_facts: patient has a history of traumatic icicle injury to the left eye
patient underwent lower eyelid reconstruction 14 years prior
patient has an ocular prosthesis
prosthesis was extruding from the socket
lesion on the left lower eyelid has been growing over the past few months
patient has conjunctival shrinkage and eyelid skin contracture
biopsy revealed nodular BCC
subsequent biopsy showed infiltrative pattern

shortlist.label: Basal Cell Carcinoma

shortlist.label: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: lesion on the eyelid with conjunctival and eyelid abnormalities, a common location for SCC

shortlist.label: Sebaceous Carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: patient has a history of ocular prosthesis and eyelid reconstruction, increasing the risk for sebaceous carcinoma

shortlist.label: Merkel Cell Carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: aggressive growth pattern and location on the eyelid, a rare but possible diagnosis

shortlist.label: Actinic Keratosis
shortlist.why_kept: patient's age and history of eyelid reconstruction, increasing the risk for actinic keratosis

raw.rationale: The biopsy revealed nodular BCC and subsequent biopsy showed infiltrative pattern, which directly supports the diagnosis of Basal Cell Carcinoma.

rejected.label: Squamous Cell Carcinoma

rejected.label: Merkel Cell Carcinoma

rejected.label: Actinic Keratosis
rejected.why: Biopsy results indicate a more invasive cancer, not a pre-cancerous condition like Actinic Keratosis
